high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a music streaming app interface, showing a song titled "Einfach da sein" by the artists KOMPROMAT, Vitalic, and Rebeka Warrior. The album cover features two individuals standing side by side against a backdrop of horizontal blinds. Both individuals are wearing white shirts and black ties, with their faces obscured by what appears to be a textured material or mask, giving them a somewhat eerie or mysterious appearance. The individuals have their hands behind their backs, adding to the formal yet enigmatic vibe.
